film_time_note: 30 fps, 1731 frames (57.7 s). Slow motion is baked in: real time until 0.35 s before the shot, then ramping to 20x for the release, the 59 ms stroke and the slide off the cradle, easing to 3x in flight, 6x for the impact and bounce, back to real time 1.2 s after impact. The dart's righting and anchoring are real time; the base's drum sequence after landing is compressed to fit inside them (rail low over the top of the aim cycle 1.33x, drum to NEUTRAL 2.67x, the 7-turn wrap 4.46x, the park 2.94x). The reel segment runs the base tidy (1.33x), the REEL engage (2.60x) and the tow (2.00x, sim tow 6 s: tension to 15 N, hold, step to 20 N), then holds. Keys are sparse: interpolate LINEARLY (loc, quaternion components, joint degrees, line points) between keys; tolerances 0.0001 m, 1e-05 quat, 0.02 deg, line 0.001 m.
units: metres, world: Z up, +X launch direction, origin = centre of the board top (z 0)
base_to_world_note: world_m = base_to_world @ S(0.001) @ M_base_mm, where M_base_mm is a part's base-frame transform: asm.json 'place' (the part's local mesh frame in the base frame with every joint at 0) composed with its joint chain, JW(joint) @ place (tools.assembly.world). objects[base:*] give exactly that per frame (set it as matrix_world). Frame 0 is the load state (tools.timeline state_at(P, 0): rail 6.02 deg, wiper 0, drum LAUNCH) = models.py's rest pose; parts that never move and sit at base_to_world @ place are omitted, parts that never move but sit off it (jointed, e.g. the rail at 6 deg) have one key. Base frame (BASE_SPEC section 2): origin on the wiper / main shaft axis, deck top z -165 mm, deck underside -173 mm: base_to_world puts the deck underside on the board top (z 0) and centres the deck footprint (with the D50 extension tile) on the origin; no rotation (+X launch azimuth).

line_wraps.note: capstan turns of the tether while the wrap cup has laid them (the main line skips them with a chord inside the drum)

sources.base: base/cad/parts (drum, frame, launch, reel, sensors: joints, kin, line_path) posed with base/out/base/asm.json
sources.shot: base/physics launcher.py chain-spring trace at 34 deg via kedge/dart_model.launch_trace
sources.flight: kedge/flight34.py strip aero + 0.25 N payout drag on the tail tie, tip-off 0.4 rad/s nose down
sources.landing: kedge/sim_righting simCore + v34_check/run34_shared.mjs SimV34 (rigid axle, tail tie), loam seed 1021
sources.line: render/motion/rope.py on the base line_path (reel.line_spans + launch.line_path)

dart.auger_note: drill_leg_L_auger (right-hand flight) turns + about its tip direction (local -x), drill_leg_R_auger (left-hand) the other way: both screw in
